messages.message: The CYP2C19 *38 allele assignment is characterized by the absence of variants at the positions that are included in the underlying allele definitions.
This comes from an outside data source which does not supply position-level detail.  For specific disclaimers and limitations, see the original genotyping source.

The SLCO1B1 genotype (star nomenclature) will be displayed if determinable with the provided VCF based on the SLCO1B1 star allele definition published by CPIC and recommendations are provided based on the genotype.

In case no genotype can be determined, recommendations are based on the rs4149056 genotype alone as per guideline. The minor C allele at rs4149056 defines SLCO1B1*5.
The SLCO1B1 *1 allele assignment is characterized by the absence of variants at the positions that are included in the underlying allele definitions.

The VKORC1 gene is on the negative chromosomal strand, all genotype calls for VKORC1 in this report refer to the positive chromosomal strand.  Therefore, genotype calls are complemented from gene bases.

guidelines.name: Annotation of DPWG Guideline for abacavir and HLA-B

implications: HLA-B*57:01-positive patients have a strongly increased risk of a hypersensitivity reaction to abacavir. 48% of the HLA-B*57:01-positive patients develop a severe and potentially life-threatening hypersensitivity reaction to abacavir
annotations.drugRecommendation:
Abacavir is contra-indicated for HLA-B*57:01-positive patients.
  1. Avoid abacavir.

guidelines.name: Annotation of DPWG Guideline for acenocoumarol and VKORC1

implications: The guideline does not provide a description of the impact of the -1639 GG genotype on acenocoumarol.
annotations.drugRecommendation: The guideline does not provide a recommendation for acenocoumarol in patients with the VKORC1 rs9923231 CC genotype (-1639 GG genotype).

annotations.drugRecommendation: "All patients should be screened for the HLA-B*5701 allele prior to initiating therapy with ZIAGEN [abacavir] or reinitiation of therapy with ZIAGEN, unless patients have a previously documented HLA-B*5701 allele assessment...ZIAGEN [abacavir] is contraindicated in patients: who have the HLA-B*5701 allele." See label for more information.
